entry.title: Roadster potrafi latać. Prezentacja przeprojektowanego modelu Tesli
entry.content: Przeprojektowany Roadster Tesli ma „silniki manewrowe do kontroli wysokości i główne silniki z tyłu, więc zasadniczo może latać jak rakieta”, opowiadał Elon Musk podczas prezentacji samochodu w Teksasie.

entry.title: Irish minister says EU budget deal still possible 'by Christmas'
entry.content: Thomas Byrne, Ireland’s Minister of State for European Affairs and Defence, said EU countries had moved “closer together” in their efforts to reach an agreement on the bloc’s long-term budget.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe

entry.title: Turcja: najcięższe od 80 lat ulewy powodują śmiertelne powodzie pod Stambułem
entry.content: Ulewne deszcze zamieniły ulice pod Stambułem w potoki, przewracając samochody i odcinając prąd. Zginęły co najmniej 3 osoby, 5 jest zaginionych, służby ratunkowe usuwają zniszczenia.

entry.title: Czuwanie przy świecach upamiętnia ofiary strzelaniny w szkole w Oregonie
entry.content: Mieszkańcy Bend w stanie Oregon gromadzą się, by uczcić pamięć trojga dzieci i nauczycielki zabitych w strzelaninie w szkole podstawowej.

entry.title: Turkey: Worst rainfall in 80 years unleashes deadly floods near Istanbul
entry.content: Torrential rain has turned streets into rivers near Istanbul, overturning vehicles and cutting off power. At least 3 people have died and 5 remain missing as emergency crews clear the wreckage.
entry.dc:creator: News

entry.title: Ukraine's Zelenskyy turns to Brussels as US support falters
entry.content: Good morning from Brussels, where Ukraine’s President Volodymyr Zelenskyy will very shortly join the EU’s 27 leaders for talks, as he aims to put Ukraine’s financing and military needs firmly at the top of their priority list. I’m Mared Gwyn. Let’s dive in.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe

entry.title: 'Well, it worked': Elon Musk unveils new Tesla Roadster that can fly
entry.content: Musk said the Roadster has "altitude control thrusters and main thrusters in the rear, so it can basically fly like a rocket."

entry.title: Europe Today: Zelenskyy in Brussels as Kyiv looks to Europe amid tension with US
entry.content: Volodymyr Zelenskyy is in Brussels for the EU summit with Washington’s support in doubt. He is set to hold his first formal bilateral talks with Hungary’s new prime minister, Péter Magyar. Also: EU leaders failed to agree on the EU budget, and we hear from Irish EU affairs minister Thomas Byrne.

entry.title: Ukraine pushes for European alternatives to US air defences and Starlink amid tensions with Washington
entry.content: As tensions between Kyiv and Washington deepen Ukraine is looking to Europe to help secure its long-term defence and technological independence. A senior Ukrainian presidential official told Euronews that concrete plans are already taking shape.
